children: Analysts surveyed by Dow Jones are forecasting inventories and average daily production of ethanol to fall back from the prior week. Analysts forecast that stocks could land anywhere from 24 million barrels to 25.24 million barrels, versus 25.04 million barrels reported by the EIA last week. Average daily production is anticipated to land anywhere between 1.085 million barrels and 1.110 million barrels a day, versus 1.110 million barrels a day reported last week. CBOT corn futures closed trading for the day down 1%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
